instruction: A professional corporate cinematic still, medium shot at eye-level. In a modern office in front of a window with horizontal blinds, the woman in the black suit (R1) stands on the left in profile, facing right. The man in the black blazer and pink shirt (R2) stands on the right in profile, facing left. They clasp their right hands in a firm handshake over a dark wooden table in the foreground. Bright, diffused daylight filters through the blinds, creating a clean, cool-toned atmosphere.
